name: Digital Media, Culture, and Communication
about: How platforms such as Instagram, TikTok and YouTube work, how organisations communicate strategically online, and how to read the data trails we leave; a 120-credit major plus minors you choose.

name: Information and Communications Engineering
about: Computer science, electrical engineering, physics and maths applied to how technical systems capture, transmit, process and secure information: circuits, sensors, networks and signal processing, with lab and project work.

name: International Business and Economics
about: Accounting, controlling, marketing, HR, logistics, data analytics and economics, taught in English throughout, with an optional double degree spending part of your studies at the University of Ljubljana.

name: Robotics and Artificial Intelligence
about: Robotics, maths, physics, software development and artificial intelligence, with hands-on seminars flying drones and programming robots, including in the university's indoor drone flight hall.

name: Social Sciences
about: Sociology, geography, psychology, science and technology studies, political science and media studies combined to analyse the challenges societies face; a 120-credit major plus minors you choose.

name: Worlds of English
about: The English language, linguistics, literatures and the cultures of the anglophone countries, with strong encouragement to spend part of your studies in an English-speaking country.

name: Business Administration
about: Business administration, economics and management with a specialisation in corporate finance or entrepreneurship and innovation, a 22-week internship semester and an optional dual degree with KEDGE Bordeaux.

name: International Business Management
about: International business administration and economics for working with partners around the world, taught entirely in English with a further foreign language on top.

name: International Wine Business
about: Business administration combined with viticulture and oenology in the Krems wine region, for managing in the wine and beverage trade; a 22-week internship in semester 5 is the centrepiece.

name: StartUp Management
about: How start-ups are planned, founded, led and scaled, from first concept to growing company, combining management theory with practical work on innovative ideas.

name: Tourism and Leisure Management
about: Business administration applied to tourism and leisure: designing tourism products, marketing destinations and staging events, with German or Spanish alongside English and a 22-week internship abroad.

name: Chemistry
about: Inorganic, analytical, organic and physical chemistry and biochemistry, with a heavy share of lab work in small groups and a choice of instrumental analysis or organic and pharmaceutical chemistry.

name: Informatics
about: Software development, data science and machine learning: how information is processed and turned into useful services, for careers such as developer, data scientist or AI engineer.

name: Medical and Pharmaceutical Biotechnology
about: Cell and molecular biology, genetic engineering and biochemistry with extensive lab practicals, plus how biopharmaceutical production processes and plants are designed.

name: Artificial Intelligence
about: Maths, computer science and modern AI methods, from machine learning and deep learning to generative AI, time series and robotics, with plenty of programming; parts can be studied remotely from Vienna or Bregenz.

name: Biological Chemistry
about: Chemistry used to understand biological processes, with hands-on lab courses: year one in Linz and year two in České Budějovice, earning an Austrian BSc and a Czech Bc.

name: Chemistry and Chemical Technology
about: Chemistry, chemical technology and process engineering, with the chemical and polymer industry around Linz offering projects and hands-on experience; some first-year courses are in German.

name: International Business Administration
about: Finance, accounting, tax, management, marketing, digitalisation and supply chains, plus economics, statistics and international law, with a compulsory semester abroad and a second language.

name: Quantum Science and Technology
about: Maths, classical and quantum physics, computer science and AI, then quantum information, computing, communication and sensors, with lab experiments and simulation from early on.

name: Transformation Studies. Art x Science
about: Run with the University of Applied Arts Vienna: running transdisciplinary projects on digitalisation, sustainability and social change, with artistic and scientific methods and design tools.

name: Business & Management
about: Business administration with business simulations, electives in entrepreneurship, sustainability, digitalisation or globalisation, a compulsory semester abroad in semester 5 and an international internship.

name: Entrepreneurship, Tourism & Leisure Business
about: Business administration for tourism, sport and leisure: management, marketing, digitalisation and sustainability, with excursions, guest experts and a final-year internship; the English major is Tourism, Sports & Leisure Business.

name: Business Administration (Online)
about: Finance, operations, HR, marketing, economics and strategy studied online through two evening webinars a week plus campus days, with a major in digital workplace learning or innovation and entrepreneurship.

name: BSc in Applied Data Science
about: Data science applied to business, services, healthcare and geographic information systems, with a bachelor's thesis and preparation for an internship, in a small private university above Vienna.

name: BSc in Human Resources Management
about: Social and organisational psychology combined with leadership, project management, marketing and strategy, for people-focused roles in companies; includes a 900-hour internship.

name: BSc in International Management
about: International business through a global lens: management strategy, managing multicultural teams and entrepreneurship, taught through real projects, case studies and business simulations.

name: BSc in International Management with Professional Experience
about: The International Management degree with an extra seventh semester: a 900-hour internship anywhere in the world, written up in an internship report.

name: BA in International Relations and Sustainability
about: Global governance and international organisations, human rights and international law, and climate policy and sustainable development, with a 650-hour internship and applied diplomacy training.

name: BBA in Tourism and Hospitality Management
about: Tourism and hospitality management for school-leavers with no prior hospitality training: markets, customer strategy and operations, with an internship semester and an option of two years in Hong Kong.

name: BBA in Tourism, Hotel Management and Operations
about: Tourism and hotel management with hands-on operational training, industry internships, study trips and an optional year at The City College of New York (the New York Extension).

name: Mathematical Foundations of Data Science
about: Mathematics, statistics and programming as the base of data science: analysing data-based problems, building mathematical models and implementing efficient solutions. No German needed.

name: Business Administration
about: A structured business core (accounting, law, economics, finance, management, information systems) ending in a market-simulation capstone, with an emphasis in entrepreneurship, HR, international business or marketing.

name: Computer Science with an Emphasis in Artificial Intelligence
about: A computer science core (software, algorithms, hardware, data management) with machine learning and data analysis, applied to fields such as healthcare, economics and life sciences in hands-on projects.

name: International Relations
about: Research-led international relations: analysing global issues from perspectives beyond your own, with methods training, real-world cases and a thesis.

name: Psychology
about: The main concepts and findings across psychology plus research methods: you form a hypothesis from current science, then collect, analyse and present your own data.

name: Strategic Communication
about: Public relations, persuasion, media literacy, corporate and crisis communication and campaigns, with strategic writing, audience research and practical exercises.

name: Comparative International Business Law
about: Public and private law compared across civil and common law traditions, with a specialisation chosen by semester 4 and a senior thesis; it does not qualify you for the bar anywhere.

name: Business and Economics (BBE)
about: Foundations of business and economics with social and legal perspectives, applied in projects, then a choice among more than 30 business, economics and law specialisations, with a class that is 60% international.

name: BA in Economics, Politics, and Social Thought
about: A major in economics or politics, taught in small seminars inside a shared core on the great texts and debates of intellectual history, with German along the way and a BA thesis in year four.

name: BA in Humanities, the Arts, and Social Thought
about: Philosophy, literature, art and political thought read closely in small seminars, with a major in art and aesthetics, ethics and politics, or literature and rhetoric, and a BA thesis in year four.

name: BA in Artistic Practice and Society
about: Make art and think about it: studio work in painting, sculpture, film, writing, performance, sound and more alongside the shared core, ending in a capstone that pairs a creative work with an academic thesis.

name: Applied Computer Science
about: Computer science taught fully online, mostly through recorded lectures with live tutorials: programming, algorithms, databases, AI and software engineering, plus a compulsory summer internship between years two and three.

name: Artificial Intelligence
about: A new degree from 2027 (accreditation expected in spring 2027): a strong maths and computer science base first, then machine learning and AI methods, with a compulsory internship and a study-abroad window in semester 5.

name: Biochemistry and Cell Biology
about: Life at the level of molecules and cells, with lab courses every year from chromatography to genetic engineering, a two-month summer internship and specialisations such as biomedicine.

name: Chemistry and Biotechnology
about: Inorganic, organic and physical chemistry combined with industrial biotechnology and bioprocess engineering, with labs, a summer internship and specialisations such as organometallic chemistry.

name: Computer and Information Technology
about: New from 2027 (accreditation expected in spring 2027): building, integrating and running secure, dependable computing and communication systems, with an internship, a study-abroad window and an optional business or engineering minor.

name: Computer Science
about: Classic computer science: C/C++ programming, algorithms and maths first, then databases, operating systems and software engineering, with a summer internship and specialisations including cybersecurity.

name: Earth Sciences and Sustainable Management of Environmental Resources
about: Processes at the Earth's surface and how natural resources are managed, mixing geoscience and geochemistry with economics, advanced field labs and a two-month internship.

name: Electrical and Computer Engineering
about: Electrical engineering centred on communications, signal processing and embedded systems, from circuits and physics labs to wireless and RF design, with a two-month internship or a start-up option.

name: Global Economics and Management
about: Economics and management for a globalised world: public policy, environmental and international economics alongside marketing, with a two-month internship, an optional semester abroad and specialisations such as econometrics.

name: Industrial Engineering and Management
about: Industrial engineering joined with management: logistics, production planning, operations research, lean methods and AI for industry, with a four-month internship in semester 5.

name: Integrated Social and Cognitive Psychology
about: Psychology joining its social and cognitive sides, from memory and learning to neurobiology and culture, with statistics and research methods throughout, a summer internship and options such as social neuroscience.

name: International Business Administration
about: International business: finance, accounting and economics first, then marketing, investments, strategy and entrepreneurship, with a two-month internship, an optional semester abroad and specialisations such as lean management.

name: International Relations: Politics and History
about: International relations taught with modern history: IR theory, political economy and the history of globalisation, then specialisations such as international law or China, with a summer internship.

name: Management, Decisions and Data Analytics
about: Business management combined with the psychology of decision-making and hands-on data analytics (machine learning, statistics in R, visualisation), with a two-month internship and specialisations such as financial data analytics.

name: Mathematics, Modeling and Data Analytics
about: Pure mathematics (analysis, algebra, number theory) paired with modelling real-world problems and data-driven methods in Python, with a summer internship and specialisations from financial maths to topology.

name: Medicinal Chemistry and Chemical Biology
about: How drugs act on the body, from molecules to physiology: organic, medicinal and pharmaceutical chemistry with chemical biology and lab work, a two-month internship and specialisations such as antibiotic discovery.

name: Physics and Data Science
about: A full physics degree, from mechanics and electrodynamics to quantum and statistical physics, taught with Python programming, modelling and data science, advanced labs and a summer internship.

name: Robotics and Intelligent Systems
about: Engineering autonomous machines: maths, physics, C/C++ and electronics first, then robotics, AI, machine learning and control, with a summer internship and specialisations such as marine robotics.

name: Software, Data and Technology
about: An advanced computing degree for students who already program well: software development, data analysis and machine learning (including Kotlin), run with the JetBrains Foundation, and an extended thesis project.

name: Bachelor in Business Administration
about: A broad business degree over seven semesters: start in English or German (all teaching is in English from semester 4), pick two of nine specialisations, and spend semester 5 abroad with an internship.

name: Bachelor in Artificial Intelligence & Data Engineering
about: Maths, computer science and machine learning taught in English and applied to business problems, ending in a capstone project, with a semester abroad at one of 150 partner universities in year 3.

name: Bachelor in Management, Philosophy & Economics
about: Management, economics and philosophy studied side by side in English, partly in small-group supervisions, with a semester abroad and an internship in year 3 and a concentration at the end.

name: Bachelor in Business Information Systems Engineering
about: Business informatics in English (programming, algorithms, databases, AI, finance) on a three-day study model, so you can work alongside your studies at a partner firm or a company you choose.

name: North American Studies
about: The US and Canada studied in English through four of six disciplines (history, culture, literature, politics, sociology, economics) at FU's John F. Kennedy Institute, with a compulsory semester abroad in year three.

name: Agribusiness
about: Business administration and management applied to the agri-food industry: three foundation semesters, a specialisation in sustainable development, animal and plant sciences or management, then an internship or a semester abroad.

name: Bioengineering
about: Biology, chemistry and engineering combined to design biotechnological processes and products; you choose industrial, pharmaceutical or agricultural biotechnology in semesters 4–5, then do a placement or go abroad.

name: Engineering
about: A broad engineering degree that opens with an orientation semester, then lets you build your own mix of electronics, robotics, computing, product development or business subjects, with an internship or semester abroad in semester 6.

name: Engineering for Sustainability
about: Mechanical engineering taught through projects, with sustainability built into every module; you shape a specialist or generalist profile, and semester 6 is a compulsory internship or semester abroad.

name: Environment and Energy
about: Environmental science, energy technology and economics around renewable energy and environmental protection: three semesters of science and engineering foundations, electives, then an internship in the sector or a semester abroad.

name: Gender and Diversity
about: Sociology, politics, cultural studies and economics applied to questions of gender and diversity, with electives in semesters 4–5 and an internship or semester abroad in semester 6.

name: Information and Communication Design
about: Visual communication design: two foundation semesters in ideas, illustration and photography, then projects in editorial, corporate, interface, web, exhibition or information design, with an internship or semester abroad.

name: Infotronic Systems Engineering
about: Computer science, electrical engineering and signal processing combined: four foundation semesters, then a specialisation such as AI, information security or drone technology, and an internship or semester abroad.

name: International Business Administration
about: Business administration for international markets: marketing, strategy, HR and accounting at the core, six electives chosen from fifteen (from consumer psychology to SAP), and a semester abroad or internship in semester 6.

name: International Business and Management
about: A generalist business degree focused on digitalisation, sustainability and international markets, with a compulsory semester abroad in semester 5 and a final semester pairing a company internship with the thesis.

name: International Relations
about: Politics, economics and law in an international setting: IR theory, institutions, peace and security first, then electives such as foreign policy, human rights and development, and an internship or semester abroad.

name: International Taxation and Law
about: International and European tax law with business administration and accounting (corporate tax, VAT, transfer pricing, tax planning), and a compulsory work placement or semester abroad in semester 6.

name: Mobility and Logistics
about: Planning and running transport, production and supply-chain systems with a sustainable-mobility angle; you specialise in logistics, technology or business from semester 4, then do an internship or semester abroad.

name: Nature-Inspired Materials
about: Chemistry, biology and materials science combined to develop sustainable materials modelled on nature; after three foundation semesters you choose biomaterials, material technology or management, then a compulsory internship or time abroad.

name: Sustainable Agriculture
about: Ecological farming and horticulture, from soil science and agroecology to precision and urban farming, with a specialisation from semester 4 and a 20-week farm internship or a semester abroad in semester 6.

name: Sustainable Tourism
about: Tourism studied through sustainable development, economics, sociology and ecology, using case studies, projects and field trips, with an internship or a semester abroad in semester 6.

name: Cultural Studies: Organization, Society, and the Arts
about: How the arts, cultural organisations and cultural theory shape society, combining cultural studies, sociology and arts management, with a semester abroad recommended in the second year.

name: Digital Media
about: Media theory and history combined with hands-on projects in video, audio, games and apps and a practical start in programming; about half the teaching is at the Hamburg Media School, with an optional Hong Kong double degree.

name: Economics
about: Economics with a strong empirical side: maths, statistics and software applied to growth, inflation, trade, environmental and behavioural questions, in small cohorts, with an optional semester abroad in year three.

name: Global Environmental and Sustainability Sciences
about: Sustainability problems studied through ecology, sociology and economics at once, with models, statistics, lab and field work; you can add an integrated year at a partner university abroad, making it a four-year degree.

name: International Business Administration & Entrepreneurship
about: Business administration combined with entrepreneurship, sustainability and digital transformation in an AACSB-accredited programme; a double degree lets you spend years three and four at the University of Glasgow.

name: Psychology
about: Psychology applied to society (social, environmental, political and organisational behaviour) with training in statistics and research methods and a compulsory internship; it deliberately leaves out clinical psychology and psychotherapy.

name: Studium Individuale
about: A liberal-education degree where you design your own curriculum: seven English core modules, including a collaborative research project, plus electives chosen from courses across the whole university.

name: Aerospace
about: Aircraft and spacecraft engineering taught in English, mainly at the Ottobrunn/Taufkirchen aerospace campus with a day a week in Garching in years 1–2; later you pick two focus areas such as propulsion, structures or fluid dynamics.

name: Bioeconomy
about: Economics and business combined with biology, chemistry and process engineering for bio-based products and the circular economy, on TUM's Straubing campus; year three adds technical electives and bioeconomy governance.

name: Geodesy and Earth Observation
about: Measuring and modelling the Earth in Munich: satellite and physical geodesy, navigation, remote sensing, photogrammetry and geoinformation, with electives such as space geodesy and machine learning on satellite data.

name: Information Engineering
about: Computer science with a business-informatics slant at TUM's Heilbronn campus: programming, algorithms, networks and maths, then electives in informatics and management, to design IT systems from the sensor to the business model.

name: Management and Data Science
about: Management built around data: every major business field alongside AI, big data and machine learning, taught in English in small classes in Heilbronn and ending in a group project on a real company or research question.

name: Management and Technology
about: A business degree (about 70%) paired with one technical subject (30%) in Munich and Garching, with management specialisations such as finance or entrepreneurship; only the Computer Engineering subject can be studied fully in English.

name: Sustainable Engineering for Materials and Processes
about: Engineering for greener materials and production on TUM's Straubing campus: materials science, chemistry, physics and process engineering, then a Materials or a Processes specialisation.

name: Sustainable Management and Technology
about: Business and economics combined with sustainability and technology (biotechnology, materials, energy and process engineering) on TUM's Straubing campus, with semester 5 kept free for study abroad.

name: Liberal Arts and Sciences
about: A four-year, English-taught liberal arts degree: a shared foundational year of academic skills and three subject introductions, then one of four majors; about 80% of students spend a term abroad, usually in year three.

name: Bachelor in International Business Administration
about: A three-year business degree in Vallendar, in English or German/English, with two internships (at least one abroad), a semester at a partner school, and a concentration from semester 4 such as entrepreneurship or business law.
